rationale: ICLR is currently trading below its session VWAP and the 9-EMA, showing bearish momentum, but it is hovering just above its daily low with a significant spread (52.1 bps) that makes entry inefficient. Given the high relative volume and the fact that the stock is already down nearly 2% in a weak market, the risk of a mean-reversion bounce off the $207.00 support level outweighs the reward of chasing the breakdown at this late stage in the session.
